edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Two Jocassee adventures worth booking, one low-effort Keowee Saturday, and the live conditions to check before the cooler goes in the car.

events.title: Jocassee Family Adventure Camp
events.body: A four-hour, all-ages day of waterfalls, swimming, caves, salamanders, and enough naturalist knowledge to make the ride home interesting. It runs every Friday with limited seating.
events.note: Adults $75 · Ages 4–15 $70 · Ages 3 and under free with a booked adult · Park entry is separate

events.title: Snorkel Adventure Tour
events.body: A new-for-2026 guided look below Jocassee’s clear surface, focused on the fish and invertebrates most boat days glide right over.
events.note: Check the operator for current times, availability, age guidance, and what to bring

plan.title: Let Jocassee do the entertaining
plan.body: Book the family adventure camp, pack actual water shoes, and leave the complicated itinerary at home.
plan.label: Check Friday availability ↗

plan.title: Keowee before the crowd
plan.body: Launch early, pick one cove, swim before lunch, and be headed toward food while everyone else is still negotiating the ramp.
plan.label: Choose a ramp →

plan.title: Look under the water for once
plan.body: Take the snorkel tour on Jocassee—or copy the spirit of it with a slow shoreline morning and fewer miles on the boat.
